cohort: The study included 172 children under 6 years old (median age 1.8 years) who were diagnosed with asthma in 2018.
finding: Loss of control events during a 3-year period among preschoolers with asthma are closely related to disease persistency, with any loss of control event significantly associated with persistence of asthma.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was included as an adjustment variable in the logistic regression model, but no specific findings related to mode of birth were reported.
followup_time: Loss of control events were assessed during a 3-year follow-up period, and asthma persistency was defined one year after the end of this 3-year follow-up (total 4 years from diagnosis).
